feedback_text: The towel set frayed after the first wash and the stitching came apart. Very poor quality.
Sound quality on these headphones is outstanding and the battery lasts all day. Highly recommend.
The blender is okay I guess. It works but the lid feels loose sometimes. Not sure if I should return it or keep it.
This product broke on the first use. The handle snapped right off when I tried to open it.
The winter holiday gift bundle packaging was beautiful and arrived before the December deadline.
